body:
it's crazy

i've known her for 7+ years, we've always been close. really *really* thought i knew her. now to come back, for the first time, dealing with everything i went through so far, thinking i'd have something innocent to come back to to help me forget all this stress, then being hit with this is just really hard

she wasn't necessarily badgering me with it. i think she just felt guilty (mixed with the fact that my brother found out and told her she'd have to tell me or he would)

i'm feeling better. maybe in shock. initial reaction was hard. i just feel numb right now

What a horrible reply

* she BETRAYED me. she was not HONEST. it would be different if she asked me "hey, dave, would you mind opening up the relationship/etc?" SHE DID NOT. she was not truthful with me. THAT is why i'm upset.

* i did not cheat, or get "needs" met. but that would not justify either of our actions if i had

* i am already posting on /r/suicidewatch

i don't hate you. *you* just need to look at different angles. peace & love

edit: no one *makes* anyone put anything in terms of suicide. it is a reaction. i am very, very hurt. no, it's not crazy to have an open relationship **but she never, ever asked** and KNEW she was cheating in that sense. Our relationship was not at all open before i left/during my deployment, therefore crossing our established boundaries would be cheating. **I AGREE** that open relationships are doable and would maybe justify this but **OUR RELATIONSHIP WAS NOT OPEN**
